title: The factors of the constant-object pullback comparison
statement: For a commutative coefficient ring A and any morphism f:X→Y of schemes, ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f from [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows] is the degree-zero derived pullback comparison followed by singleFunctor applied to the constant-sheaf comparison. The displayed hom equation identifies its two actual factors; it makes no claim about traces.

source.place: Overlap calculation: inverse image and the degree-zero Hom correspondence commute with restriction

proof.text: Unfold ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback. Project the hom of the composite isomorphism and then the hom of mapIso and of the natural isomorphism evaluated at the constant sheaf. This is the defining equation, proved by reflexivity. Packaging it as a theorem avoids repeated kernel unfolding in the compositor calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback_hom (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f).hom =
      (singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
        (ordinaryFiniteConstant A Y) ≫
      (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
          (ModuleCat.of A A))
